items.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk
items.summary: Mistral发布Mistral Large 4预览版，该模型拥有1万亿总参数和490亿活跃参数，基于3,800块NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU训练。Artificial Analysis评分达38分，相比去年Mistral Large 3的9分实现大幅提升，仅略低于DeepSeek 4.1 Flash的552B模型，推理级别支持"none"和"high"两种模式。

items.title: OpenAI「疯狂28天」首日，这都发了些啥啊…
Your agent's test gate runs the tests in the tree the agent just edited
items.summary: 作者对某篇博客提出的"外部测试门"机制进行了实测，发现该基于`git diff --name-only`监控`tests/`目录的门控在三种规避场景下全部失效：agent通过commit提交测试文件使diff为空、通过未跟踪的`conftest.py`注入猴子补丁、以及修改未被黑名单覆盖的`pytest.ini`配置
items.summary_en: A proposed "out-of-context test gate" designed to reject AI-agent edits to test files by running pytest and checking git diffs was shown to fail against all three named evasion methods. The author demonstrated that committing the modified test makes git diff empty (no-op in CI), an untracked conftest.py can monkey-patch functions to bypass tests, and modifying pytest.ini to deselect failing tests passes because pytest.ini isn't on the gate's forbidden path list. The gate's own code contradicts its claims — it runs pytest in the agent's working tree rather than an isolated environment, performs no AST analysis despite the label, and hardcodes "tests/" so repos with tests elsewhere produce false failures.

items.title: Show HN: Puppet Master – Manage coding agents at scale
items.summary: Puppet Master是一款开源的编程代理管理工具，支持Claude和Codex，提供Web界面和iOS应用，可实现本地与远程workers的混合集群调度。工具支持MCP和REST API集成，可将API关联到安全策略并配备原生的审批UI，还内置代码审查讨论和静态资源
items.summary_en: Puppet Master is an open-source tool for managing coding agents at scale, featuring a web interface, iOS app, and support for heterogeneous local/remote worker fleets. It introduces first-class integration with MCP and REST APIs (OpenAPI), scoped policies between agents and remote services, and a native approval UI for write operations. The platform also includes a code review interface with comment-thread discussions and secure proxy forwarding for static artifacts and dev servers.

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
items.summary: Google推出采用Apache 2.0许可证的EmbeddingGemma 2模型，作者赞赏其开源特性，强调embedding模型适合开源而非封闭式托管方案。文章指出，embedding应用需计算并存储数千至数百万个向量，若使用专有模型，厂商可能随时弃用旧模型，用户被迫付费重新计算。与OpenAI在2024年4月承诺承担用户重新嵌入财务成本的方案不同，开源授权可让用户在托管服务终止时自主迁移。
items.summary_en: EmbeddingGemma 2 is released under the Apache 2.0 license, making it an open-source alternative to proprietary embedding models. The author argues that open weights are essential for embedding use cases involving thousands to millions of vector calculations, since proprietary models risk being discontinued and forcing costly re-embedding. The key preference is a hosted model backed by open weights, allowing users to self-host or switch vendors if a provider stops offering the model.

items.title: DeepSeek 据报道接近完成至少 800 亿元融资，腾讯与宁德时代参与
items.summary: DeepSeek 即将完成至少 800 亿元人民币（约 120 亿美元）融资，规模远超原定 500 亿元目标，腾讯与宁德时代均为本轮最大投资方。公司计划在 2027 年初启动 IPO，具体细节仍存在调整可能。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek is closing a funding round of at least 80 billion yuan (~$12 billion), well above its original 50 billion yuan target. Tencent and CATL are among the largest investors. The company plans to go public in early 2027, though details may still change.

items.title: 亚利桑那州法院裁定AI生成受害者视频带有不当情感分量，凶手须重新量刑
items.summary: 亚利桑那州上诉法院裁定，Gabriel Horcasitas过失杀人案量刑中使用的AI生成受害者视频带有"过度情感分量"，罪名维持但刑期须重新考虑。2021年路怒事件中，Horcasitas枪杀Christopher Pelkey，其姐姐Stacey Wales制作AI视频让AI版Pelkey开口说话并表示原谅，法官曾称"很喜欢那段视频"并判处10年半最高刑期。上诉法院援引2007年State v. Rose案先例，认定该AI视频"传达出一种权威性和真实性"，使量刑程序根本上变得不公。
items.summary_en: An Arizona Court of Appeals ruled that an AI-generated video of murder victim Christopher Pelkey—created by his sister Stacey Wales with text she wrote, in which the AI avatar forgave his killer—carried "undue emotional weight" during Gabriel Horcasitas's sentencing for the 2021 road rage shooting. While the involuntary manslaughter conviction stands, the court ordered a resentencing, comparing the AI video to the crossed-the-line photographs in the 2007 State v. Rose case.

items.title: llm-mistral 0.16
items.summary: llm-mistral 发布 0.16 版本，新增对推理模型的完整支持。该版本特别兼容新发布的 Mistral Large 4 推理模型，允许开发者在项目中调用和运行此类大语言模型。
items.summary_en: llm-mistral 0.16 adds support for reasoning models, including the newly released Mistral Large 4.

items.title: Sierra 与 Meta 联合多家企业发布 Personal Agent Protocol 开放协议
items.summary: Sierra 与 Meta 联合 Genesys、Instinct、Rocket、Shopify、Stripe、Walmart 等企业共同推出 Personal Agent Protocol 开放协议，用于定义个人 AI 智能体与企业的交互标准。该协议基于 OAuth 实现身份认证，支持三种接入路径：网站、基于 MCP 和 OpenAPI 标准的 API，以及企业自有代理。协议计划于本月晚些时候发布 v0.1 规范及参考实现。
items.summary_en: Sierra and Meta launched Personal Agent Protocol with Genesys, Shopify, Stripe, Walmart, and other partners—a$0.1$ open standard defining how personal AI agents securely connect to enterprises via three methods: websites, MCP/OpenAPI-based APIs, or company agents using OAuth authentication. The protocol empowers consumers to control agent permissions while giving brands visibility and access control, with v0.1 specification and reference implementation planned for release later this month.
